attempts.summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (CentOS Stream 10, MariaDB 10.11.18 + Galera 26.4.27) across node1/node2/node3. Verified multi-master write propagation, availability during a member outage, and automatic resync on rejoin. Completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes with confirmed boot-ID changes and post-restart cluster/data recovery.
